name: Top Performance Classroom
source: A group of unfamiliar teenagers were transported to a completely new environment for them - Top Performance School. However, the school is not the ordinary. They were convinced that here they will have many different events that they will have to overcome. But no one began to explain exactly what these events will be. Good or bad? It doesn't matter, it's already started. The students will have to face pleasant and not so pleasant emotions, during which they will become closer to each other. Or move away, it's matter of luck.
